teaser.en: A dark-barked ebony cousin of the coastal grasslands, cut for poles and recognised by leaves that are rusty underneath.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa eboni mwenye gome jeusi wa nyika za pwani, unaokatwa kwa nguzo na kutambulika kwa majani yenye rangi ya kutu upande wa chini.
teaser.dg: Ndugu wa *ebony* wa nyasi za pwani, wenye gopha ra rangi ya jiza, unaokatwa kpwa nguzo na unaomanyikana kpwa makodza ga rangi ya kutu uphande wa photsi.

summary.en: *Mkulu* is a small evergreen tree of coastal bushland and grassland, a relative of ebony with greyish-black bark. Its wood is cut for poles.
summary.sw: *Mkulu* ni mti mdogo wa kijani kibichi wa vichaka na nyika za pwani, jamaa wa eboni mwenye gome jeusi-kijivu. Mti wake hukatwa kwa nguzo.
summary.dg: *Mkulu* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, wa vitsaka na nyasi za pwani, ndugu wa *ebony*, na gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu na nyiru. Nyama za muhi nkukatwa kuhenda nguzo.

about.en: *Mkulu* is an evergreen tree up to about 10 metres tall, with greyish-black bark typical of the ebony family. Turn a leaf over and you will see the clue: the underside is covered with rusty hairs. The fruit is small, up to about 2 centimetres across.
about.sw: *Mkulu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi unaofikia urefu wa mita 10 hivi, wenye gome jeusi-kijivu la kawaida ya familia ya abunusi. Geuza jani uone dalili yake: upande wa chini umefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya kutu. Tunda lake ni dogo, lenye upana wa hadi sentimita 2 hivi.
about.dg: *Mkulu* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wa hadi phephi mita 10, wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu na nyiru dza mihi ya jamii ya *ebony*. Uchipendula kodza undaona alama: uphande wa photsi ukafwinikpwa ni nyere za rangi ya kutu. Tunda ni ridide, ra hadi phephi sentimita 2 kuvuka.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and grassland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na nyika za pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na nyasi za pwani.

uses.en: The wood is used for poles.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda nguzo.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *mkulu* for *Diospyros cornii*; it is also the Swahili and Giriama name. The Mgombato dictionary, however, defines *mkulu* as the jackal-berry, *Diospyros mespiliformis*, with the Swahili *mpweke*, and refers to *m'bara*. Pakia calls the jackal-berry *mbara*. The name may be used for more than one ebony.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanatoa jina la Kidigo *mkulu* kwa *Diospyros cornii*; pia ni jina la Kiswahili na la Kigiriama. Hata hivyo, kamusi ya Mgombato inafafanua *mkulu* kuwa ni *jackal-berry*, *Diospyros mespiliformis*, yenye jina la Kiswahili *mpweke*, na inarejelea *m'bara*. Pakia anauita *jackal-berry* *mbara*. Huenda jina hili linatumika kwa eboni zaidi ya mmoja.
names.dg: Pakia na chitabu cha ICRAF analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mkulu* kpwa *Diospyros cornii*; piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiryama. Ela kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mkulu* kukala ni *jackal-berry*, *Diospyros mespiliformis*, na dzina ra Chiswahili *mpweke*, na inamuambira mutu alole *m'bara*. Pakia anauiha *jackal-berry* *mbara*. Labuda dzina hiri nkuhumirwa kpwa aina zaidi ya mwenga ya *ebony*.

reason.en: Jackal-berry, the ebony Mgombato calls mkulu
reason.sw: Jackal-berry, eboni ambao Mgombato anauita mkulu

reason.en: Another Diospyros of the coastal bush
reason.sw: Diospyros nyingine ya vichaka vya pwani

reason.en: Also cut for poles and building
reason.sw: Pia hukatwa kwa nguzo na ujenzi
reason.dg: Naye piya nkukatwa kuhenda nguzo na kudzenga

mgombato: mkulu (mi) jackal berry tree (Diospyros mespiliformis); mpweke. (See: m'bara)
